The closest match is [1], which uses LLMs to extract formal symbolic rules with temporal operators and delay semantics for multivariate time series, aiming to explain causal relations and delayed effects. [1] It relies on simulator-generated counterfactual trajectories and clustered temporal patterns to produce verifiable causal rules, so it directly combines LLMs, logical rules, and time-series causality. [1]

Also related are [8], which does time series causal discovery with simulator-generated interventional distributions, and [2], which uses causal intervention and variable-level alignment for LLM-based time series forecasting, but neither is focused on learning logical rules from time-series causality as directly as [1]. [8, 2]
